monitor_settings: revision.monitors.default_suite defaults (betting gain4/cap9/window50; msr 5 stakes; eSR alpha_design=1e-3 min_gap .02; ewma lam .05; window_binomial W=200)

variant_notes.markov: markov_rho (paper: phi) = lag-1 corr of misses over successive DEFECTIVE items (markov_over=defect)
variant_notes.board: consecutive boards of 50 items; Beta random effect, ICC on r (0.2) or on pi (0.1) separately
variant_notes.ramp: linear r from 0.05 at tau-1 to r1 at tau+L-1; null path variant = same-length ramp 0.05->0.10
variant_notes.prevalence: applied to all paths (null and harmful); step pi 0.1->0.2 at tau; sinusoid pi(1+0.5 sin(2 pi t/1e4))
variant_notes.delay: geometric on {0,1,..} mean 500; lognormal median 500 sigma 1 (mean 824); batch release at ends of 1000-item shifts (mean ~500)
variant_notes.labelnoise: e10=P(label 0|true miss)=0.05, e01=P(label 1|true non-miss)=0.01; noisy-label rate r'=r(1-e10)+(1-r)e01

calibration.rule: h*=max(h_const,h_path) two-point composite null, randomized ties, target 0.02, 20000 streams per null path, role=calibration
calibration.recalibrated: same rule on null streams of the variant (SECONDARY)

validation.ci: exact Clopper-Pearson; gate one-sided 95% upper <= 0.03 with Bonferroni over family
validation.family: nominal-threshold FA cells: 7 monitors x 2 q x 2 null paths (const010, path) x 13 variants = 364

seeding: rng.stream_states(role, 12, condition=10*q_index+path_index, replicate); condition ids shared across variants (common random numbers; paired with base)
classification_prespecified: FA control broken: nominal-threshold FA simultaneous one-sided upper bound > 0.03 AND point FA > 0.03; inflated-but-gated: point FA > 0.02 with sim. lower CP bound > 0.02
planning_part: stressor 7 by exact DP (theory/exact_cusum.py, converse.py); see plan_dp.py
